research.title: Regression Uncertainty Under Structured Missingness
bullets: Designed experiments comparing regression uncertainty estimates across feature missingness mechanisms, imputation strategies, and training sample compositions.
Analyzed interval coverage and prediction error across missingness patterns, distinguishing effects of imputation choices from uncertainty estimation procedures.

research.title: Probability Calibration Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing temperature scaling, isotonic regression, and importance-weighted calibration under simulated covariate shifts in classification datasets.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, proper scoring rules, and subgroup calibration to characterize sensitivity to validation composition and density ratio estimation.

publications.title: Validation Composition and Importance Weighting in Probability Calibration Under Covariate Shift
Subgroup Reliability Diagnostics for Calibrated Tabular Classifiers Under Covariate Shift

work.title: Data Import Validation and Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented validation checks for tabular data imports, handling malformed records and maintaining consistent error responses across service endpoints.
Added regression tests for parsing failures and duplicate submissions, and investigated defects using application logs and reproducible test cases.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors, selecting regularization strengths through cross-validation on training data.
Compared held-out prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, examining sensitivity to resampling and regularization choices.

projects.title: Kernel Classification with Nonlinear Decision Boundaries
bullets: Implemented kernel support vector classification and logistic regression baselines, using nested cross-validation to separate hyperparameter selection from evaluation.
Compared predictive performance and decision boundaries on synthetic nonlinear datasets, examining effects of feature scaling, class overlap, and kernel bandwidth.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Clustering Under Model Misspecification
bullets: Implemented expectation-maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal and full covariance matrices, including initialization checks and convergence monitoring.
Compared mixture clustering with k-means on synthetic datasets, evaluating assignment agreement and sensitivity to cluster overlap and covariance misspecification.
